args.query: mock fetch in Vitest tests with MSW handlers

results.title: ky HTTP client with hooks and retries, tested with MSW + Vitest
results.summary: A ky 2 API client (prefix option, state-object hooks) with auth hooks, retry on 5xx and typed JSON, tested offline with MSW's Node server in Vitest.

results.title: Redux Toolkit + RTK Query with tag invalidation and optimistic updates, tested with MSW
results.summary: An RTK Query API slice with auth headers from Redux state, tag-based cache invalidation and an optimistic update with rollback, tested offline in Vitest against MSW 3 request handlers without rendering React.

results.title: openapi-fetch typed client with MSW
results.summary: Call a typed OpenAPI paths client with openapi-fetch against MSW handlers, covering GET/POST and error status offline.

results.title: ofetch HTTP client mocked with MSW
results.summary: Call APIs with ofetch against an MSW 2 HTTP worker in Node, covering JSON responses, query params and error status mapping offline.

results.title: graphql-request client with typed operations, mocked by MSW graphql handlers
results.summary: Call a GraphQL API with graphql-request (variables, headers, error handling) and test offline with MSW's graphql.link(url).query/mutation handlers (msw 3 API). Install uses --legacy-peer-deps because graphql-request 7 still peers on graphql 14 - 16, but the client passes its tests against graphql 17.

results.title: ioredis cache-aside with TTL, tested with ioredis-mock (Vitest)
results.summary: Cache-aside helper on ioredis with JSON values, TTLs, stampede-safe single flight and invalidation, tested offline with ioredis-mock in Vitest. Install uses --legacy-peer-deps because ioredis-mock 8 still peers on ioredis ^5, but the mock passes its tests against ioredis 6. vite is pinned so Vitest still resolves under legacy-peer-deps.

results.title: Typed fetch API client tested with MSW + Zod
results.summary: A typed fetch client that parses responses with Zod, tested offline by intercepting requests with MSW's Node server.

results.title: urql core client with MSW: auth headers, document cache and errors
results.summary: Test an @urql/core client offline against MSW graphql handlers: auth via fetchOptions, cache-first hits vs network-only, mutation invalidation in the document cache, and CombinedError for GraphQL and HTTP failures.

results.title: Octokit REST client with MSW: pagination, early stop and errors
results.summary: Test an @octokit/rest client offline with MSW handlers for api.github.com: paginate through Link headers, stop paging early with done(), create issues with auth, and map 404 RequestErrors.

results.title: tRPC 11 client + server over fetch with superjson (Vitest)
results.summary: End-to-end typed tRPC 11: fetch adapter server, createTRPCClient with httpBatchLink and superjson transformer for Dates and Maps, tested in-process with Vitest.
